study_frame.question: individuelle Abfahrtsenergie/Anschlussfenster, V2G nur bei expliziter Erlaubnis

typed_symbols: vehicle: finite ID; t: interval; availability[v,t]: Bool3; delivered[v,t]: kWh; required[v]: kWh; departure[v]: time
component_interfaces: individuelle Abfahrtsenergie/Anschlussfenster, V2G nur bei expliziter Erlaubnis
assumptions: EV1,EV2 departure requirements 4,6 kWh; available before deadline; delivered totals 4,6; V2G not permitted absent authority
external_obligations: forall v, sum delivered before departure >= required[v]; zero outside connection window; no negative charging absent V2G permission
observables: individual deadline energy, availability, V2G authority
